desc: Text-to-SQL 评测集：25 道中文业务问题，每题附标准 SQL。评测口径为「执行准确率」——比对生成 SQL 与标准 SQL 的结果集是否一致（忽略列名差异，数值保留两位小数）。

questions.q: 一共有多少笔订单？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.q: 一共有多少位客户？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.q: 已完成状态的订单有多少笔？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已完成'

questions.q: 被取消的订单有多少笔？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已取消'

questions.q: 所有订单的平均金额是多少？（保留两位小数）
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),2) FROM orders

questions.q: 最贵的商品价格是多少？
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM products

questions.q: 钻石等级的客户有多少人？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE level='钻石'

questions.q: 金额超过 5000 元的订单有多少笔？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 5000

questions.q: GMV（已完成和已发货订单的总销售额）是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货')

questions.q: 客单价是多少元？（GMV 口径下的平均订单金额）
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货')

questions.q: 上海的 GMV 是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.city='上海' AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')

questions.q: 每个城市各有多少笔订单？
questions.sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.q: 每个城市的 GMV 是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

questions.q: 各个品类的销售额是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC

questions.q: 销售额排名前三的品类是哪些？
questions.sql: SELECT cat.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.q: 上个月（相对今天的上一个自然月）的 GMV 是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now','-1 month') AND status IN ('已完成','已发货')

questions.q: 最近 30 天产生了多少笔订单？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= date('now','-30 days')

questions.q: 手机数码品类下一共有几件商品？
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id=cat.id WHERE cat.name='手机数码'

questions.q: 每个客户等级的平均订单金额是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY AVG(o.total_amount) DESC

questions.q: 销售额最高的商品是哪一件？给出商品名。
questions.sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: 销量（件数）最高的商品一共卖了多少件？
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: GMV 最高的城市是哪一个？
questions.sql: SELECT c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: 消费总额最高的客户一共消费了多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: 按月的 GMV 趋势是怎样的？
questions.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',created_at), ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',created_at) ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)

questions.q: 本自然年（今年）的 GMV 是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y',created_at)=strftime('%Y','now') AND status IN ('已完成','已发货')
